==Overview==
Being a larger version of [[Ram]]s, Heavy Rams have similar appearance with its counterpart, notably being larger, and has additional attacks:

*Rams at front, dealing Physical damage.
*Leaps after a short wind up, and followed by a ground pound, dealing Physical damage to Operators around.
*Charges ahead, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back.
*A stronger ram after a charge up, dealing Physical damage. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
